The overlay runs file_log_works with only private-fixture-state appended to the temporary agent.log. Go test exits 1 at unexpected log contents and prints the synthetic path marker. The log-level marker is absent.

limits: Both fixture runs use a temporary file and fake service dispatch and Event Log callbacks. They require no elevation, symbolic links, tar extraction, or Hyper-V.
